messages.content: Find a pet-friendly train station in Miami

function.name: find_hotel
function.description: Search for hotels based on specific criteria like price range and pet policy. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to book the hotel.

max_price_per_night.description: The maximum amount you are willing to pay per night. This is a float type value.

pet_friendly.description: Whether the hotel should allow pets. Defaults to false.

message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Feature | Details | |---------|---------| | **Station Name** | **Miami Central Station** (formerly Miami Intermodal Center) | | **Address** | 1 SE 1st Street, Miami, FL 33131 | | **Transit Services** | • Amtrak Silver Service (Silver Meteor & Silver Star)
• Brightline (Miami to West Palm Beach & Orlando) | | **Pet Policy** | • **Amtrak** – Small dogs (≤ 20 lb) allowed in carriers on all Silver Service trains. Dogs must be leashed or in carriers while on the platform and during boarding. No pets on Brightline’s “Premium” class, but pets in carriers are permitted on Brightline’s “Standard” class with a fee.
• **Brightline** – Pets in carriers up to 20 lb are allowed on Standard class cars. No pets on Premium class. | | **Why It’s Pet‑Friendly** | • The station’s design includes ample space for walking pets on the platform.
• Nearby amenities (e.g., pet relief areas) are available at the adjacent Miami Intermodal Center complex.
• Both Amtrak and Brightline provide clear guidelines and support for traveling with pets, making this the most convenient option for pet owners in Miami. | **Quick Tips for Traveling with Your Pet from Miami Central Station** 1. **Check the Pet Carrier Size** – Ensure your carrier meets the 20 lb limit and is well‑ventilated. 2. **Bring Identification** – A collar with ID tags and a copy of your pet’s vaccination records. 3. **Plan for Breaks** – If you’re taking a longer trip, schedule stops at pet‑friendly restrooms or parks along the route. 4. **Arrive Early** – Give yourself extra time to navigate the station with your pet and to handle any last‑minute paperwork. If you need more detailed information about specific train schedules, pet fees, or additional amenities, let me know!
